content.text:
**Finding: LICENSE — compliant (no redline).**

Section 13 satisfies every preferred element:

| Element | Where met |
|---|---|
| Extends to affiliates | 13.1 ("Customer, its Affiliates"), 13.2 ("Customer and its Affiliates") |
| Extends to contractors acting on Customer's behalf | 13.1 ("contractors acting on their behalf"); 13.2 ("permit contractors to support") |
| Paid-up licence perpetual | 13.2 ("a perpetual, irrevocable... licence") |
| Paid-up licence irrevocable | 13.2 (same); reinforced by 10.x survival of paid-up licences |
| Subscription licence terminable only for uncured breach | 13.3 (no revocation/suspension except material uncured payment or use breach, after notice and cure) |
| Transferable to successors | 13.3 plus 24.1 (Affiliate or M&A successor without consent) and 24.4 (no Vendor termination/repricing on our change of control) |

No revocability at Vendor's discretion, and 13.4's conduct restrictions expressly preserve authorized security testing and use of Customer Data and output. The only observation — that 13.3 keys revocation to a "payment or use breach affecting the licensed item" rather than any material breach — is narrower than the standard and works in our favour, so it is noted rather than flagged.
